name: anchor_bb_klconst
notes: Both promising changes together: rollout 256 and constant teacher KL 0.15 (never fades), 600 updates. anchor_bigbatch was provisionally ahead on both seeds, anchor_klconst kept its level to u600 where anchor_long collapsed. Read only together with the single-change runs. Base recipe = anchor recipe (start kickstart u600 = x_kickstart_best, rule bots + self-play, teacher jit8, w_wall 0.02, lr 5e-5). Seed noise of that recipe is about 65 Elo, so variants run on more than one seed and are compared with the plain recipe of the same seed (seed 7 anchor_wall_repro, 11 anchor_wall_s11, 23 anchor_wall_s23). Trained on the MacBook Air, night of 2026-11-23. Judge by Elo and agf / aga after the ladder has settled.
